question: Who among the following was the first President of the Indian Olympic Association (IOA) ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sir Dorabji Tata**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sir Dorabji Tata** was the first President of the Indian Olympic Association (IOA).
 
• He was instrumental in India's participation in the Olympic Games.
 
• Under his leadership, India sent its first team to the 1920 Antwerp Olympics.
 
• He was a prominent industrialist and philanthropist, and a key figure in the Tata Group.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)**

 
 
• The IOA is the body responsible for selecting athletes to represent India at the Olympic Games, Asian Games, and other international athletic meets.
 
• It also manages the Indian contingent during the events.
 
• The IOA was established in 1927, and it is recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC).
 
 
 
• **Olympic Games**
 
 
• The Olympic Games are leading international sporting events featuring summer and winter sports competitions.
 
• Thousands of athletes from around the world participate in various competitions.
 
• The Games are held every four years, with the Summer and Winter Games alternating by occurring every four years but two years apart.
 
 
 
• **Tata Group**
 
 
• The Tata Group is an Indian multinational conglomerate headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
• It was founded in 1868 by Jamsetji Tata; the group gained international recognition after purchasing several global companies.
 
• It is one of India's largest and oldest industrial groups.
